name: Freelance value chain
summary: A lead freelancer and their contributors, each bonded, paid in one settlement.
description: Digital work is rarely one person: a lead deliverable draws on contributors — an editor and a translator, a developer and a designer, a producer and a session musician. Here each contributor is a co-equal bonded order in the same process: everyone delivers over the encrypted hand-off channel, everyone's stake secures everyone else's work, and the client's single resolution pays the whole chain at once. The agency without the agency.
